other_gates.note: settle + archaeologist turn present; foreground workman reaction restrained — the subject-first GenHQ prompt did NOT visibly strengthen the head-turn vs v3, because the posed start_image still anchors him

comparison_conclusion: v4 (timestamped format, ~75w, 2K, 3 refs) is EQUIVALENT to v3 (prose ~459w, native, 6 refs) on every gate — ratio identical, reactions similarly restrained. So for a START-IMAGE-anchored shot the prompt format barely moves the needle (the frame drives it), but the GenHQ format gets the same result at 1/6 the words + cleaner refs + 2K crispness = strictly better to ADOPT going forward.
